positions.title: Geschäftsführer / COO
positions.description: ThingOS is an IoT technology company. We are a growing team of currently 15 experts in the fields of computer science, electrical engineering, UX design and mechanical engineering. Using our profound tech expertise, we are developing IoT products and services - enabling our customers to create the next generation of IoT devices.  We cover the full product lifecycle - ideation, evaluation, development, production, service and support. ThingOS is located at the ARENA2036 – adding connectivity to smart production systems in the area of Industry 4.0. Another area are smart home applications, where we are connecting services, lights and sensors via Bluetooth® mesh and further technologies.
